purpose: TASK-181 (with TASK-018 of PR #205 by WaimateWihongi): the USB capsule for the native Driving Force Pro wheel. The derived iop/hw.cpp sends the OHCI registers to native/usb_ohci.cpp while the virtual DFP is plugged in (wheel.toml enabled = true, or GT4_DFP=1); otherwise the donor's register stub answers as before.
game_pins: Game pins that include the capsule name it as usb_capsule and usb_capsule_sha256 (the SHA-256 of runtime.json), as for spu2_capsule: scripts/pin_task134_build.py --usb-capsule private/slice409-usb-runtime.
checks: CTest native_usb_dfp and native_wheel; Python test_usb_runtime.py; gates of v2.00 and Spec II builds with the capsule against the rc14 PGO builds (private/task134-tools/gates6.sh): docs/WHEEL-NATIVE-DFP.md.
limits: Without a wheel file the game reads the donor stub, so builds with and without the capsule run the same; with the virtual DFP plugged in the game's own USB driver runs (docs/WHEEL-NATIVE-DFP.md).
Save states do not include the USB model.
